population: Identical retained C1 channel of A4096 and B4096; TRAIN only; failed/discarded costs unchanged

methods.join: Exact export ID; manifest numeric SHA and parent; each integer anchor matched against exact legal list; no missing or duplicated joins.
methods.observed: Sum actual retained forward-confirmed visit counts. A and B complete C1 histograms exactly equal.
methods.fork_origin: Only anchor 0 is STUDENT_AT_FORK_ANCHOR; positive anchors are EXPERT_AFTER_FORK. Original parent plus intervention tick identifies a provenance point, not equality of full physical states.
methods.probabilities: For export e with n_e legal anchors and parent p with k_p exports and N_p legal anchors: 1/(8*n_e), 1/(4*k_p*n_e), 1/1665, or 1/(4*N_p). Sum per-anchor probability over the requested group; multiply by 32768 only for hypothetical expected counts.
methods.limits: No learned-outcome estimate from reweighting. No new state/RGB bytes read. State-only or complete-physical-state deduplication remains unmeasured.
